spans.s: अतुंद a. Not bulky, lean, lank.
अतुर a. Ved. Not rich or liberal.

आतुर a. [ईषदर्थे आ, अत्-उरच्]
1 Hurt, injured.
--2 Suffering from,
influenced or affected by,
tormented, afflicted; रावणावरजा तत्र राघवं
मदनातुरा

; so
काम˚, भय˚, व्याधि˚ &c.
--3 Sick (in
body or mind), disabled, diseased;
आकाशेशास्तु विज्ञेया बालवृद्धकृशातुराः

.
--5 Weak,
feeble, incapable of doing
anything.
--रः
1 A patient, one suffering
from a disease;

.
--2
Illness, disease.
--Comp.
--शाला
an hospital.
--संन्यासः a kind of
संन्यास (taken by a person when
sick and grown hopeless of life).

अतुल a. [न. ब.] Unequalled,
unsurpassed, matchless, peerless,
incomparable, very great;
भयमतुलं गुरुलोकात्

; so ˚पराक्रम,
˚रूप &c.
--लः The sesamum seed
and plant (तिलकवृक्ष).
अतुल्य a. Unequalled &c.

अतुषार a. Not cold.
--Comp.
--करः
The Sun; so अतुहिनकर, ˚रश्मि, ˚धामन्
˚रुचि &c.

अतूतुजि a. [न तुज्-कि द्वित्वदीर्घे] Not
a donor or giver, not liberal (अदातृ).

अतूर्त a. [न तूर्यते, तुर्-हिंसायां] Ved.
Not obstructed or stopped or
injured, unhurt.
--र्तं The unlimited
space, sky.
--Comp.
--दक्ष a. Ved.
whose plans cannot be obstructed
or are unhurt.
--पथिन् a. Ved. whose
path cannot be obstructed.
आतुः [अत्-उण्] A raft, float.
आतुच् f. Evening, growing dusk.

आतुज् m. Destroyer of enemies
or giver of wealth.

आतुजि a. Ved. [तुज्-इन्]
1
Rushing on, hastening towards.
--2
Carrying off (आदातृ).
--3 Injuring,
destructive (हिंसक).

आतुद् {c6c} U. To strike, push, spur
on, stir up.

आतुर्यं [आतुरस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
1 A
kind of fever.
--2 Sickness.
